entity.summary: Brazil-based centralized cryptoasset exchange operated by Digitra.com Ativos Digitais Ltda., providing account-based crypto trading, deposits, withdrawals, custody, staking, OTC services, and API access.
entity.notes: The current first-party site exposes login, account opening, app access, crypto purchase, staking, OTC, and API surfaces. Current terms identify Digitra.com Ativos Digitais Ltda. and define cryptoasset purchase and sale intermediation, deposits, withdrawals, custody, order-book trading, and asset-to-asset exchange. No exact launch date or lifecycle event is asserted.
